capabilities: Convert highlights, underlines and bolded text into clozes automatically
Create clozes with hints from selected text via the editor menu
Toggle cloze visibility by clicking or hovering in reading mode
Reveal parts of a cloze dynamically from a context menu
Style cloze appearance with CSS variables
disambiguation: Not a spaced-repetition flashcard system; it only hides and reveals text in the note itself for review.
extras: Notes a limitation: PDF export shows all clozes hidden or all visible, not individual states. The README also points readers to the Spaced Repetition plugin for full flashcard workflows.
intentEvidence: Inspired from anki cards, this simple plugin for Obsidian enables you to create a cloze from special text segments
motivation: The author was inspired by Anki cards but wanted a lighter helper for reviewing pages and articles rather than full flashcard review.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn text segments into hidden clozes you can toggle while reviewing a page or article.

relations.evidence: Inspired from anki cards, this simple plugin for Obsidian
the Cloze plugin serves as more of a helper for reviewing pages/articles

summary: Cloze tool that hides highlighted, underlined, bolded or selected text in reading mode and reveals it on click for self-testing.
